verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents AI-driven reconciliation that runs automatically and continuously, plus a built-in Command assistant that takes bookkeeping tasks such as journal entries and bulk categorization; accountants can be invited to review transactions and comment. However, nothing documents an agent running a bounded month-end close or surfacing exceptions, and the MCP layer for external agents is only announced as coming "soon." Mercury itself says the books are not on autopilot. Missing for 10: a documented month-end close workflow, exception flagging or queues, close-package preparation for sign-off, a shipped (not "soon") API/MCP for external agents, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
